ads.headline: Meta Ads interest surging; service businesses competing harder for cheap traffic
actions: Audit your ad relevance score today - competitors likely bidding up your audience
Test geo-targeting smaller 5-mile radius to reduce CPC in saturated markets
Shift $5 of daily budget to video ads - lower CPM than static creative currently
ads.source: Google Trends meta ads spike (63) + r/FacebookAds weekly discussions

creative.headline: I can't generate strategic recommendations without performance data
actions: Google Trends shows zero search volume for relevant keywords this week
No top-performing content discussions were provided to analyze
No failure patterns or audience complaints were shared to identify opportunities
creative.source: Insufficient data provided — Google Trends returned all zeros; content performance metrics and audience feedback missing

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: I cannot provide accurate intelligence without actual data

No real service business owner posts shared — cannot extract pain points
No top account performance metrics included — cannot determine what's working
